newsitem.title: JAPAN: Support for Japan's Hashimoto slips in poll -- NHK.
newsitem.headline: Support for Japan's Hashimoto slips in poll -- NHK.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's approval rating slipped five percentage points to 43 percent from a previous survey, NHK public broadcasting network reported on Monday.
NHK said its telephone survey of 2,000 voters showed 39 percent of respondents did not approve of the prime minister, a five point increase over the network's previous survey in January.
Nearly half of the respondents who gave Hashimoto a negative rating said they had no faith in his policies, NHK said.
Respondents named economic recovery and administrative reform as priority policy issues Hashimoto's Liberal Democratic Party government should tackle, NHK said.
